projects.title: work
projects.summary: This site. About, projects, art, and accessibility controls, exported as static Next.js for GitHub Pages.
highlights: Static export for GitHub Pages under /work
JSON-driven about, projects, now, work cases, and art gallery
Client accessibility prefs: themes, fonts including OpenDyslexic, contrast and motion

projects.title: GoldGrapher
projects.summary: Money management dashboard: track income, set a budget, and log progress.
highlights: Next.js front end with FastAPI and Pydantic on the back end
Firebase Admin for account and data storage
Poetry-managed Python package (midasaccount)

projects.title: Elysium Discord Bot
projects.summary: Multi-purpose Discord bot. Main job is free Twitch live notifications, with moderation, utility, and music commands as well.
highlights: Twitch watchlist with custom live channel and ping message
Music playback in voice channels via yt-dlp (play, skip, queue, pause)
Slash commands for help, runtime, suggestions, and staff alerts
MIT licensed, discord.py 2.5+
projects.notes: The instance I host is limited to a support server and a friend's server while features are still thin.

projects.title: Riget Zoo Adventures
projects.summary: T-Level 2024 full-stack app for a combined zoo and hotel: room booking, tickets, memberships, and rewards.
highlights: Room booking, zoo tickets, memberships, and rewards points
Vite + React Router front end with Bootstrap and MDB UI
Flask API with SQLite and bcrypt password hashing
70-hour T-Level Digital Production client project

projects.title: Sgàthach Discord Bot
projects.summary: Python Discord bot for moderation, engagement, and community management.
highlights: Auto role assignment and auto-moderation for spam and profanity
YouTube and Twitch stream announcement hooks
Birthday announcements, ticketing channels, and welcome messages
GitHub commit alerts for watched repositories
projects.notes: MIT licensed. Earlier Discord bot before Elysium.

projects.title: LoginSystem
projects.summary: College winter project: React front end, Flask API, SQLite auth with password hashing.
highlights: Customer sign-up and login against SQLite
Password hashing on the Flask side
Axios JSON between Vite React UI and Flask
Separate React, Python, and database folders in the repo

projects.title: GMC Wordle
projects.summary: GM Skills hackathon Wordle-style game. Team of three, 3rd place in web development.
highlights: Hidden word from a CSV list, limited guesses with letter feedback
Next.js front end with Primer React and styled-components
Flask + pandas API with CORS for get-word and guess checks
3rd place in web development at GM Skills Bury 2024

projects.title: Asteroid Blasters
projects.summary: Small pygame shooter. Dodge falling hazards and keep the ship alive.
highlights: Start menu and 1600x900 windowed playfield
Player HP, movement, and falling star hazards
Custom art assets and window icon
projects.notes: Window title in code is Asteroid Evaders. MIT licensed.
